title: Build Connected workspace and service setup
head: Final evidence commit is the PR head; implementation_head identifies tested code.

github_recheck.parent_ci: All active checks passed; conditional checks skipped.
github_recheck.base_decision: Continue the staged D stack on corrected D26. Owner main preserved; no isolated D01 or main compatibility claim.

source_pins.F-25: No all-state PR found by final title query; activation remains gated.

design_reference.inspection: Native Connected frame and UI35 handoff inspected in in-app browser; screenshots retained.
design_reference.limits: Eight runtime layouts, not eight native exports or a pixel diff. Complete UI35 coverage frame not inspected; dedicated setup subframes not individually certified.

host_requirements: Inject authenticated F22 v1 reader, real ConnectionSetup, per-tab sessionStorage and openLegacyConnectionSetup.
Retain controller per authenticated scope; retire on logout or replacement; never fall back to specimen data.
F25 supplies exact management navigation and current device update metadata.
Verify combined deployed contracts and existing OAuth/device behavior before release activation.

implementation: Compact devices/services with actual device status, account labels and consistent icon/name across setup.
Search, scroll and focus restoration; cancel, expiry, reconnect, explicit canonical-account selection and verified completion.
Fresh exact canonical read before success; saved credentials and installed pieces never imply authentication.
Structural bridge delegates setup persistence and verification to F22; no hard dependency on unmerged exports or new durable engine.
Partial-source, stale, unsupported, unavailable and uncertain states stay distinct; scope loss purges visible accounts.
Device update/revoke/enrollment delegate to existing management owner without executing effects.

verification.note: Also passed on implementation commit through the normal hooks.

commit_hooks.note: Normal license, migration, template, package, related-test and type checks; no bypass or coauthor trailers. Final evidence commit also uses normal hooks.

browser.method: CUA in-app Chromium interaction and read-only DOM geometry
observed: Catalog filter and return search, scroll and focus.
Identity across browser/setup/completion; unconfirmed return stays pending.
Remount does not lose the attempt; cancel, expiry and lost-start recovery.
Exact account picker; configured credentials stay distinct from authentication.
Visible offline device plus update/revoke/settings handoffs; no device effects.
Chat draft continuity across eight layouts; long content wraps without horizontal overflow.
Keyboard Tab reaches setup controls, terminal headings receive focus.
Partial-source warning, unavailable state, and light/dark narrow account selector.

not_run: Combined live authenticated F22/F25 deployment and production activation
Real OAuth grant, provider authentication, credential write, device enrollment/update/revoke
Native OS reduced-motion setting and inherited shell motion recertification
Full repository local suite; GitHub CI reported separately

preview.isolation: Loopback-only static fixture server; no daemon, API proxy or user vault.

rollback: Remove optional registration or switch back to existing settings UI. Revert card commits if needed; no migration reversal or effect replay.
private_progress: Updated outside product repository; shared Drive roadmap unchanged.
